base_url.description: Sentry address. Default https://sentry.io; set it for EU (https://de.sentry.io) or self-hosted.

project.description: Only this project (its slug). Default: the whole organization.

sort.description: date (last seen, default), new, freq or user.

stats_period.description: Time window: issues seen in it, and their counts. 24h (default), 14d... With project set, only 24h or 14d.

token_command.description: Command that prints the auth token.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding an auth token. Default SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN.
